content: Q: Can I pay by mobile banking? A: Yes, mobile banking is accepted.
Q: Can I pay by card? A: Yes, card payment is accepted.
Q: What do unpaid and paid mean on my bill? A: Unpaid means the bill has not been paid yet. Paid means the payment has been recorded.
Q: How do I get an invoice? A: Ask reception for your invoice. The AI assistant can also show your bills.
Q: Why do consultation fees differ? A: The consultation fee depends on the doctor. Senior consultants charge more.
Q: Where can I see a doctor's fee? A: Each doctor's fee is shown in the doctor list when booking.
Q: Do I pay in advance and can I get a refund? A: No, payment is made after the visit. There is no advance payment and no refund process.
Q: What are your opening hours? A: The clinic is open Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
Q: Are you open on Friday? A: No, the clinic is closed on Friday and public holidays.
Q: Where is the clinic? A: The clinic is at House 27, Road 9/A, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209.
Q: What is the clinic phone number? A: The clinic phone number is +880 1711-000000.
Q: Is there parking at the clinic? A: Only limited street parking is available.
Q: Is the clinic wheelchair accessible? A: Yes, there is a wheelchair ramp and a lift at the entrance.
Q: Which languages do your staff speak? A: Reception staff speak Bangla and English.
Q: What should I do in an emergency? A: The clinic is not an emergency service. Call 999 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
Q: What can the AI assistant do? A: The AI assistant can look up your appointments, prescriptions, bills, and profile. It can also prepare bookings, cancellations, and reschedules as proposal cards.
Q: Is the AI assistant giving medical advice? A: No, the assistant gives general information and specialization guidance only. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose.
Q: Can the AI assistant book for me? A: The assistant prepares a booking as a proposal card. Nothing changes until you press Confirm.
Q: Are my chats with the assistant private? A: Yes, your chats are private to your account.
Q: What if the AI assistant makes a mistake? A: Do not press Confirm on a wrong proposal card. Contact reception if something looks wrong.
